hypothesis: A self-hosted model can select and execute native fortress actions through the same exploratory grammar and factual observations without transferring game data to a hosted provider.
notes: This is a separate local development condition, not equivalent to a hosted model or a year-two comparison.
A literal loopback endpoint is required. Remote native workers may reach the operator-owned local model through a private, loopback-bound SSH tunnel; there is no hosted-model fallback.
Zero describes absent metered provider API charges. Local hardware, electricity and existing infrastructure costs are separate and not assumed to be zero.
Native action choices remain the model's own; grammar constraints never prescribe strategy or synthesize WAIT. Model and context limitations are recorded as experiment findings.
